newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank says comfortable with zloty level.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank says comfortable with zloty level.

text.p: The Polish central bank said it was comfortable with the zloty at 1.9 percent above the parity rate and would closely watch the unit's further moves after the zloty slid down from 2.44/2.27 percent in early trade.

"Some of those foreign players who took heavy losses in the Czech Republic are now selling some of their Polish portfolios to take profits and make up for the losses," said Malgorzata Sawicka, forex dealer at bank Handlowy SA.
